warning_validity.sole_spine: event-conditioned temporal precedence is not predictive warning validity
warning_validity.claim_ceiling: The six frozen rules have specificity 0 and binary-marker AUC 0.5 in both tested ensembles; this does not imply that genetic diversity contains no predictive information generally.

state_validity.sole_spine: coarse marginal equality does not guarantee transition equality; under the locked aligned/anti-aligned contrast that hidden state distinction propagated from little loss-risk contrast at generations 5-10 to about five percentage points by generations 20-40; scalar process labels also do not transport across distinct operators
state_validity.claim_ceiling: Finite and closure-specific tests do not establish a universal propagation cutoff, state completeness, operator equivalence, a natural-system timescale, or validated predictive warning.

natural_data_four_gate_program.conditional_stretch_target: Methods in Ecology and Evolution only after a separate new-method gate with reusable implementation and simulation benchmarks
natural_data_four_gate_program.claim_ceiling: Heterogeneous natural systems are not pooled and do not validate the warning rules or the synthetic state closure.

archive.purpose: Preserves the pre-split integrated narrative required by historical manuscript and bundle contracts; it is not an active publication path.
